title: We accidentally built a nightclub inside our new game engine.
author: inigid
selftext:
So I've been building a path traced renderer written in Zig, with full dynamic shadows and reflections now for coming up to a year.    Matryoshka.  I plan on releasing open source sometime in 2027.  I'm thousands of hours and commits into it at this point, but still a lot to be done.

Yesterday, I started working with Astra to make this demo, which turned into quite a fun experience!

I kept egging Astra on to add more and more stuff to see how the engine would take it.  And this is what we ended up with.   
  
On stage is my engine's mascot, "Matryoshka", dancing with her best buddy "Fabergé".   The song lyrics are about the engine by the way.

The models are a bit crap right now, but I'm not a 3D artist.  I think they do have a bit of charm though.  At least I think so.

It's all running on my 3090 here on CachyOS.  No hardware RTX - just pure software Vulkan Compute, and then recorded in OBS live from the engine.

I'm quite happy with the lighting work I did for it, which took a significant part of the time since I started on the engine.  Especially those projected volumetric spotlights.     Talking of which, here is a fun thing.   Those projected gels on the stage and the back screen, are actually Markdown documents - don't ask - lol.

Because that's how I roll :-)

Well, hope you enjoy the demo.  Thought it might be nice to show something a bit different to the group.

Welcome to Club Matryoshka!

PS.  Happy to talk a bit about the engine and demo more if anyone is interested.

replies.author: guile2912
replies.body: The cat did, walking on the keyboard. Then agents went full coding.

replies.author: inigid
replies.body:
Haha, it really was.  So I had built this street scene demo...  "Matryoshka Punk 1977"

Basically Cyberpunk but set in 1977, and it had this nightclub, Matryoshka.

It was going to be my showcase demo.

Hang on, I think I have a screenshot.

So then I was thinking well I want to make a promo video with a bunch of tasty looking scenes, and had made that song.

Thought, oh it would be good if Matryoshka could dance to the track.  As you do.

Then it was like, ughhh, maybe she needs a stage.   Then oh, she has a stage but she looks a bit lonely.  That's when I invented Fabergé haha.

Astra was lolling along at this point and decided it would be good to choreograph the two dancing.   Who am I to disagree?!

So that happened!

Then I thought wait, this is the inside of Matryoshka's Nightclub isn't it mmmm..

And it got progressively sillier from there.

By the time I knew it we had girls on podiums, parallax crowd cards, spotlight projectors and a drone flying around.

It has been a strange 24 hours that's for sure.

Now I have to figure out how you get from the street level into the club, especially as Matryoshka is quite picky who she lets in I think.

And that's the story I'm sticking to.
